name: ai-ready
description: Report documentation and enforcement gaps for AI-agent work without a score, apply only the reviewed drafts (guidance docs: a root AGENTS.md with a one-line CLAUDE.md that imports it, module docs, decision records, verify.sh, a docs check, lint or architecture-test drafts), and draft lessons from session and PR corrections in Codex. Release history lives in CHANGELOG.md.

interface.shortDescription: Find and close guidance and enforcement gaps for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Report which guidance documents and checks a repository has and whether CI runs them, sort documented rules by whether a tool can enforce them, and apply only the reviewed drafts.
defaultPrompt: Report documentation and enforcement gaps in this repository.
Apply the approved items from the latest AI-Ready gap report.
Turn the corrections from this session into enforcement or anti-pattern drafts.
